bio: Treat yourself and loved ones to a classic British traditional Afternoon Tea at the Apex City of Bath Hotel.  Enjoy a tantalising selection of freshly cut finger sandwiches, decadent sweet and savoury treats, homemade fruit or plain scones, along with a choice of a selection of Twinings teas and speciality coffee by Origin. Served in the lounge, Afternoon Tea is the perfect way to sip and enjoy while watching the world go by. The Afternoon Tea pairs perfectly with a glass of Lanson le Black Champagne, or house prosecco.  Why not turn your Afternoon Tea into a full afternoon of indulgence? Add a 1 hour relaxing spa session in the hotel’s facilities. Relax in our sauna and steam room, before a dip in the pool, and finish off by lying on our heated loungers. It’s the perfect way to get you in the mood for tea.  Afternoon Tea is served Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 12pm to 4pm and costs £26 per person.
